name: Influence Maximization under Diffusion Models
problem_statement: Given a directed graph with edge-level influence probabilities and a declared stochastic diffusion model, select a seed set of a given size that maximizes the expected number of vertices eventually activated.

normalization: Treat edge weight as the independent-cascade activation probability, or as linear-threshold edge weight depending on diffusion_model.
Reject edge weight outside [0,1] for independent_cascade.
Collapse parallel edges per diffusion_model's combination rule (declared explicitly, since probabilities do not sum like capacities).
Remove self-loops; they do not affect diffusion.

problem_inputs.name: diffusion_model
problem_inputs.description: Stochastic process governing how activation spreads from seeds.

problem_inputs.name: seed_set_size
problem_inputs.description: Number of seed vertices to select (the budget k).

problem_inputs.name: vertex_thresholds
problem_inputs.description: Per-vertex activation thresholds for linear_threshold; null means thresholds are drawn uniformly at random per the model's standard definition.

problem_inputs.name: estimation_method
problem_inputs.description: Technique used to estimate expected spread while selecting seeds.

problem_inputs.name: approximation_guarantee
problem_inputs.description: Target multiplicative approximation ratio to the optimal expected spread (e.g. 1 - 1/e for the standard greedy guarantee).

problem_inputs.name: failure_probability
problem_inputs.description: Allowed probability that the returned seed set fails to meet approximation_guarantee, under the sampling method's own randomness.

required_outputs.name: seed_set
required_outputs.description: Selected seed vertices, with cardinality equal to seed_set_size.

required_outputs.name: expected_spread
required_outputs.description: Estimated expected number of activated vertices when diffusion starts from seed_set.

required_outputs.name: guarantee_met
required_outputs.description: Whether the returned seed_set is certified to meet approximation_guarantee under failure_probability.

optional_outputs.name: marginal_gains
optional_outputs.description: Estimated marginal expected-spread gain contributed by each seed, in selection order.

optional_outputs.name: sample_count
optional_outputs.description: Number of reverse-reachable sets or Monte Carlo simulations used to produce the estimate.

optional_outputs.name: confidence_interval
optional_outputs.description: Statistical interval around expected_spread for the estimation method used.

solution_semantics.objective: Choose seed_set of size seed_set_size maximizing expected_spread under diffusion_model, where expected_spread is the expectation over the model's randomness of the number of eventually-activated vertices.
solution_semantics.exactness: Exact computation of expected_spread is #P-hard in general; guarantee_met=true requires the disclosed approximation_guarantee and failure_probability to hold under the estimation_method's established theoretical bounds.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: seed_set contains each vertex at most once.
solution_semantics.ordering: seed_set has no required output ordering unless marginal_gains is returned, in which case order reflects the greedy selection sequence.

validation_rules: seed_set has exactly seed_set_size distinct vertices that exist in the graph.
expected_spread is non-negative and at most the total vertex count.
Re-estimating expected_spread for the returned seed_set via independent simulation falls within confidence_interval or a stated tolerance.
vertex_thresholds, when supplied, are all within [0,1] for linear_threshold.
edge_cases: seed_set_size greater than or equal to the vertex count makes expected_spread equal to the vertex count.
A graph with no edges gives expected_spread equal to seed_set_size regardless of diffusion_model.
All edge probabilities zero under independent_cascade gives expected_spread equal to seed_set_size.
Disconnected components require seeds to be distributed to maximize total spread, not concentrated in one component.

correctness: expected-spread estimate agreement with high-sample-count simulation oracle
guarantee validity under disclosed sampling parameters
performance: reverse-reachable sets or simulations per second
